epics.description: Pi-5 automotive Event Data Recorder: a dedicated-reader -> in-process pub/sub bus -> consumers (persistence/vault/triggers/display/server-sync) architecture. Dual-role Pi (Role 1 = B-104 canonical raw emitter unchanged; Role 2 = real-time edge safety + event recorder). Multi-sprint, V0.3x+. Hardware-gated phases (9-DoF IMU + light sensor, earliest IRL ~mid-July 2026); the bus-contract + ECMLink feasibility spike are hardware-independent. Atlas Watch List A-14. Ruling: offices/architect/reports/2026-06-16-edr-vs-b104-architecture-ruling.md.
